items.title: DevFest Uyo 2026
items.text:
Date: 21 November 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 21 November 2026, 14:30 UTC
Location: Jacksville Events Place, UNIT E, PLOT 1, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo 520231, Akwa Ibom
Registration: Free registration

Welcome to DevFest Uyo 2026 Where Builders Shape the Agentic Era

DevFest is the world’s largest decentralized developer conference, powered by Google Developer Groups (GDGs) across the globe. It is your community-driven launchpad to connect with local peers, learn directly from industry experts, and build with Google’s cutting-edge tools.

This year’s theme, Build, Secure, Scale: Developers and Builders in the Agentic Era, tackles the shift toward autonomous systems, generative AI, and intelligent workflows. Whether you are shipping production code, hardening applications against emerging threats, or engineering systems to handle enterprise traffic, you’ll walk away with practical, real-world skills to lead the next generation of software.

What to expect:

-

Deep-Dive Technical Sessions: Practical insights covering Android, Cloud, Web, Flutter, and Google AI / Gemini.

-

Hands-On Workshops: Build intelligent, resilient applications from scratch.

-

Local & Global Networking: Meet passionate engineers, designers, founders, and Google Developer Experts (GDEs) in your area.
